title: Small, Mediocre Storage Cube
text:
Small, Mediocre Storage Cube. I got this to hold towels on our covered patio near the pool. While it worked it really was too small.

The size, being 1 cubic foot, is really too small to hold much of anything - maybe it would be good for legos or something like that. It really didn’t work for my purposes though the product itself is decently made.

The lid has an ok cushion but, again this only stands 1 foot high so it’s really too short to use as a foot stool. I’ve ended up using it to house my pool testing equipment and it has worked well for that.

While this is an OK product, I definitely recommend paying attention to the small dimensions prior to ordering.
